title: Café in München
blurb: Lena works in a small café in Munich. One morning a new customer walks in. A gentle story about work, coffee and getting to know someone — read it at your level.

lines.en: Lena works in a café in Munich.
The café is called Café Luna.
It is small and very cosy.
Every morning Lena opens at seven.
She makes coffee and cuts cake.
The first guests come at half past seven.
Lena knows almost all the guests.
Mr Weber always drinks an espresso.
Mrs Koch takes tea with milk.
Today a new guest comes into the café.
He is tall and wears a blue coat.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Good morning," he says.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "Good morning," Lena answers.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "What would you like?" she asks.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "A coffee, please," says the man.
Lena makes the coffee and smiles.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "Are you new here?" she asks.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Yes, I have lived in Munich for a week," he answers.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "My name is Daniel."

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "Welcome to Munich, Daniel," says Lena.
The next morning Daniel comes again.
He sits down by the window.
Lena brings him a coffee.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Thank you," he says.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "Do you work near here?" Lena asks.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Yes, I work in an office on Marienplatz."

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I'm an architect."

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "That's interesting," says Lena.
Daniel reads the newspaper every morning.
He stays half an hour.
Then he goes to work.
On Thursday it rains hard.
Daniel comes into the café soaking wet.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "You need a hot tea," says Lena.
She gives him the tea and a piece of cake.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "The cake is from me," she says.
Daniel laughs for the first time.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Thank you very much, that's very kind."
That day he stays an hour.
Lena thinks about him all day.
Lena works with her friend Sophie.
Sophie is young and very funny.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.en: "Who is the man over there?" Sophie asks.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "That's Daniel, a new guest," Lena answers.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.en: "He looks good," says Sophie with a smile.
Lena laughs, but she doesn't answer.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.en: "You like him," says Sophie.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "He's only a guest," Lena says quickly.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.en: "Of course," says Sophie. "Only a guest."
On Friday Daniel comes at eight.
Sophie is standing behind the counter.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.en: "Good morning," she says loudly. "Lena is in the kitchen!"
Lena goes red.
She comes slowly out of the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "Good morning, Daniel."

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Good morning, Lena."
Sophie looks at the two of them and smiles.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.en: Later she says: "He isn't coming for the coffee."

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "The coffee here is very good," says Lena.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.en: "Yes," says Sophie. "But he comes because of you."
It's Saturday and the café is full.
Daniel sits at his table by the window.
He waits until the café gets emptier.
At four o'clock he stands up.
He walks slowly to the counter.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Lena, I'd like to ask you something."
Lena puts the cup down and listens.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Do you have time on Sunday?"

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "We could eat together."
Lena says nothing for a moment.
Her heart beats fast.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "Yes," she says quietly. "I'd love to."

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Daniel smiles. "At seven?"

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "At seven," Lena repeats.
He writes his number on a napkin.
Then he goes out of the café.
Sophie comes straight over to Lena.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.en: "What did he say?" she asks.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "We're eating together tomorrow," says Lena.
Sophie almost shouts with joy.
On Sunday evening it isn't raining any more.
Lena wears a blue dress.
She's nervous and arrives too early.
The restaurant is near the river.
Daniel is already waiting outside the door.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "You look beautiful," he says.
For the first time he says "du".
They sit down at a table by the window.
The waiter brings the menu.
Lena orders fish, Daniel takes the soup.
They talk about their families.
Daniel has a brother in Hamburg.
Lena talks about her mother in Rosenheim.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "Why did you come to Munich?" she asks.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Because of work," he says. "And now I'm glad to stay."
They eat slowly and laugh a lot.
After the meal they walk along the river.
The city is quiet and the air is cool.
At the bridge Daniel stops.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I'm glad that I came into your café."
On Monday Daniel doesn't come to the café.
He doesn't come on Tuesday either.
Lena often looks towards the door.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.en: "Maybe he's ill," says Sophie.
On Wednesday Lena writes him a message.
He only answers in the evening.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I'm sorry. We have a problem at the office."

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I work until eleven every day."
Lena understands, but she's sad.
On Thursday the café is very full.
A cup falls on the floor.
Lena cuts her finger.
Sophie helps her straight away.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.en: "Go home," says Sophie. "I'll do this."
Lena goes home and falls asleep early.
At midnight her phone rings.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: It's Daniel. "Are you still awake?"

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "I am now," says Lena, laughing.
They talk for an hour.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: In the end Daniel says: "I miss you."
On Saturday it rains all day.
At six o'clock Lena closes the café.
Outside Daniel is waiting without an umbrella.
His jacket is completely wet.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "How long have you been standing here?" Lena asks.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "For twenty minutes," he says.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "You're crazy!"
She takes his hand and they run together.
They arrive at Lena's place.
Her flat is small but warm.
Lena gives him a towel.
Daniel looks at the photos on the wall.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Is that your mother?"

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "Yes, the photo is old."
Lena makes tea for them both.
They sit on the sofa and listen to the rain.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I have something for you," says Daniel.
He gives her a small key.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "The key is for my new office."

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I want you to see it first."
A year has passed.
Café Luna is well known in the city now.
Lena has two new colleagues.
Sophie still works at the weekend.
Daniel comes every morning at half past seven.
He drinks his coffee and reads the newspaper.
But today he is very quiet.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: "What's wrong?" Lena asks.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "I have a question," he says.
The café suddenly goes quiet.
Sophie turns the music off.
Daniel stands up and goes to the counter.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "Lena, do you want to live with me?"
He shows her a second key.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "The flat has a big window."

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: "And the kitchen is big enough for two."
For a moment Lena can't speak.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: Then she says: "Yes. Of course yes."
The guests in the café clap loudly.
Sophie cries and takes a photo.
